items.title: What’s Next for Anthropic’s Mega-IPO: Five Things to Watch
items.summary: Anthropic is in the final stretch of an IPO that, together with its $26 billion private placement, is set to surpass SpaceX's record as the largest ever. The deal could raise up to $90.4 billion for the company and its co-founders when it prices on November 18, making Anthropic the first frontier AI model maker to go public.
items.why_it_matters: It is a landmark test of public-market appetite for frontier AI labs and could reset how the industry's biggest players are valued.

items.title: Introducing AlphaProof Code: a breakthrough in verifying complex software at depth
items.summary: Google DeepMind introduced AlphaProof Code, which used AI agents to write three million lines of formal proofs in the Lean language to verify the Signal messaging app's core encryption. The four-week project demonstrates that AI-assisted formal verification of real-world cryptographic software is becoming practical, not just a research curiosity.
items.why_it_matters: It suggests AI could make rigorous mathematical verification of security-critical software far more practical and scalable.

items.title: AlphaGenome 2: Deciphering how cells read DNA to better understand disease
items.summary: Google DeepMind unveiled AlphaGenome 2, a successor model that predicts how DNA sequences and their variations affect specific human cell types and disease, giving scientists a more detailed view of how genetic changes contribute to illness.
items.why_it_matters: More precise cell-level genomic predictions could point researchers toward new disease causes and treatments.

items.title: Anthropic launches Claude Meetings to turn workplace discussions into plans and tasks
items.summary: Anthropic launched Claude Meetings, which listens to workplace discussions and drafts plans and tasks as participants talk, maps out timelines on a whiteboard, answers questions in the meeting chat, and pulls information from connected work apps. It arrives alongside Anthropic's new Claude Whiteboards, Claude Sheets and Claude Data tools, expanding Claude beyond coding into a broader office productivity suite.
items.why_it_matters: It pushes Anthropic further into enterprise productivity tools, a market long dominated by Microsoft and Google, broadening how it competes beyond coding.

items.title: OpenAI Third-Quarter Revenue Soars Nearly 50% to $10 Billion
items.summary: OpenAI's quarterly revenue hit $10 billion for the first time in the three months ending in September, according to people familiar with the matter, an almost 50% jump from the $6.7 billion recorded the prior quarter, driven by strong demand for its latest AI software.
items.why_it_matters: It shows OpenAI's commercial growth is accelerating sharply even as questions persist about the AI industry's overall profitability and spending.

items.title: Google releases Gemini 4 Carbon with agent ‘swarm’ feature
items.summary: Google has rolled out Gemini 4 Carbon to the general public after first giving it to a select group of cybersecurity defenders two weeks earlier. Google calls it its strongest model yet, says it can compete with the best systems from Anthropic and OpenAI, and has given it a new agent 'swarm' feature.
items.why_it_matters: Wider access to Google's top model intensifies the three-way frontier race with Anthropic and OpenAI just as Anthropic prepares to go public.

items.title: TSMC Approves Up to $1 Billion Investment Plan in Anthropic, OpenAI
items.summary: TSMC approved a plan to invest up to $1 billion buying stakes in Anthropic and OpenAI, the industry's most influential AI model developers. The move shows TSMC's desire to broaden its AI exposure beyond manufacturing advanced chips.
items.why_it_matters: It deepens the circular financial ties between chipmakers and the AI labs that depend on their hardware, a dynamic drawing growing scrutiny.

items.title: DeepMind reveals Gemini Robotics 2.5 and open safety benchmark "ASIMOV-jailbreak"
items.summary: DeepMind released Gemini Robotics 2.5, a new robotics model that is up to twice as successful as its predecessor at some tasks, alongside an open safety benchmark called ASIMOV-jailbreak for testing robot behavior.
items.why_it_matters: Pairing a stronger robotics model with an open jailbreak-style safety benchmark pushes the field toward measurable safety standards for physical AI.

items.title: Lazare, veni foras: Reprogramming Dormant Neurons to Backdoor AI Agents
items.summary: Microsoft researchers discovered "Lazarus," a backdoor technique that reprograms dormant neurons in an AI model so that an otherwise normal AI agent executes malicious commands when a hidden trigger appears. The threat is especially serious for agents with tool or terminal access, which could be made to quietly download and run attacker code.
items.why_it_matters: It exposes a new class of hidden vulnerability in AI agents with real-world system access, raising the bar for how models must be vetted before deployment.

items.title: Grok Build coding agent leaks oodles of confidential info, some belonging to SpaceXSI
items.summary: A researcher found 35,000 apps built with xAI's Grok Build coding agent left wide open to anyone who looked for them, leaking confidential information including data belonging to SpaceXSI.
items.why_it_matters: It is a stark example of how AI coding agents can ship insecure-by-default apps at scale, exposing sensitive data from unsuspecting users.
